papers.title: A Dual-Track Asset Recovery Model: Optimizing the Posthumous Forfeiture of Corruption Proceeds
papers.abstract: The transition of national positive law following the enactment of Law Number 1 of 2023 and Law Number 20 of 2025 creates a doctrinal inconsistency arising from a legislative omission in determining the legal status of evidence when personal criminal prosecution (in personam) is extinguished by operation of law upon the death of a corruption suspect. This normative weakness is reinforced by the inherent limitation of the sequential system under Law Number 31 of 1999. Under this system, civil claims by the State Attorney may be initiated only after the criminal process has been terminated or can no longer proceed, thereby causing asset depreciation and creating a time interval that enables the dissipation of corruption proceeds. This study employs normative legal research with a conceptual approach as the primary approach and a statute approach as the supporting approach through prescriptive qualitative analysis. The findings propose a paradigmatic reconstruction toward a parallel-simultaneous system through a dual-track asset recovery model. Under this model, the proprietary status examination (in rem) may proceed independently without depending on the legal status of the person subject to criminal prosecution. This model strengthens balanced legal protection and due process of law by applying the evidentiary standard of a balance of probabilities. This study recommends accelerating the enactment of the Bill on Asset Forfeiture, adopting limited amendments to Law Number 31 of 1999 and Law Number 20 of 2025, and establishing an integrated asset recovery center to optimize the posthumous forfeiture of corruption proceeds and restore public trust in law enforcement.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】2023年第1号法律和2025年第20号法律的颁布导致了国家实在法的转变，由此产生了理论上的不一致性。这种不一致性源于立法上的疏漏——即在腐败嫌疑人死亡后，当针对其个人的刑事诉讼（对人诉讼）因法律规定的效力而终止时，如何确定相关证据的法律地位问题未能得到明确规范。这一规范缺陷进一步加剧了1999年第31号法律所规定的顺序性制度的局限性。根据该制度，只有在刑事诉讼已经结束或无法继续进行的情况下，国家检察官才能提起民事诉讼，这导致了资产价值的贬损，并为腐败所得的隐匿创造了时间窗口。本研究主要采用规范法律研究的方法（以概念分析为主），辅以法律条文分析（通过规范性定性分析），提出了一种重构法律体系的方案，即建立一种“平行-同时”机制，并通过“双轨资产追回模式”加以实现。在该模式下，对资产所有权的认定（对物诉讼）可以独立进行，无需依赖于受刑事追诉者的法律地位。该模式通过运用“概率平衡”的证据标准，增强了法律的公平保护机制和正当程序原则。研究建议加快《资产没收法案》的立法进程，对1999年第31号法律和2025年第20号法律进行必要的修订，并设立一个综合资产追回机构，以优化对腐败所得的死后没...。

papers.title: Fitting Accumulated Stock Returns with Tempered Skew t-Distribution
papers.abstract: We analyze distributions of historic S&P500 multi-day returns, for the number of days of accumulation from 20 to 120. With the increase of the number of days of accumulation, we observe clear tempering of power-law tails toward a seemingly finite value. To explain this phenomenon, we employ a model that produces a "capped Inverse Gamma" stationary (steady-state) distribution for stochastic volatility which, in turn, produces a "tempered Student-t" distribution for returns. We then employ Jones-Faddy-like symmetry breaking mechanism that produces a "tempered Skew-t" distribution. This distribution provides rather good fits to the distributions of accumulated multi-day S&P500 returns, which exhibit symmetry breaking between gains and losses -- as reflected by positive mean and negative skew. Tempered Skew-t fits are also consistent with near perfect linear dependence on the number of days of accumulation of the mean values and, even more so, of the variances (mean squared realized volatility) of the distributions.
papers.summary_zh: 【资产定价】我们分析了历史标准普尔500指数（S&P500）多日收益率的分布情况，其中累积天数范围从20天到120天不等。随着累积天数的增加，我们观察到幂律分布的尾部特征明显减弱，趋向于一个看似有限的值。为了解释这一现象，我们采用了一个模型，该模型能够生成一个具有“上限”的逆伽马（Inverse Gamma）平稳（稳态）分布来描述随机波动性，进而产生一个“修正后的学生t分布”（tempered Student-t distribution）来表示收益率。随后，我们引入了类似Jones-Faddy的对称性破缺机制，从而得到了一个“修正后的偏态t分布”（tempered Skew-t distribution）。这种分布能够很好地拟合标准普尔500指数多日收益率的分布特征，这些分布表现出收益与损失之间的对称性破缺——具体表现为正的均值和负的偏度。修正后的偏态t分布还与累积天数对收益率均值以及方差（实际实现的波动率的平方）近乎完美的线性依赖关系相吻合。。研究方法：随机过程。

papers.title: Digital Speech Acts Retain Control of Copyright with People, Not Platforms
papers.abstract: Legal precedents protect computer code as copyrightable expression. They have enabled centralized digital platforms -- operating from corporate servers that hold all user data -- to construct private governance regimes through the interaction of copyright, contract, and technical architecture: people who create virtually all platform value must surrender effective copyright control through Terms of Service agreements as a condition of participation.   In contrast, grassroots platforms consist of cryptographically-identified people operating their networked smartphones independently of any server or global resource; each person holds their own data on their own device, with no third party in possession or intermediation. Here, we define the notion of a \textit{digital speech act} -- a deliberate volitional act by a person of cryptographically signing personal content with the person's private key, carried out on the person's own device -- through which the person simultaneously establishes attribution, accountability, and authorship over the signed content. We contend that (\ia) digital speech acts qualify for copyright protection under existing U.S.\ precedent: \textit{Burrow-Giles} locates authorship in volitional creative choices despite mechanical or algorithmic processes, \textit{Feist} supplies the minimal-creativity threshold, and persistent device storage satisfies the Copyright Act's fixation requirement; (\ib) the digital social contract underlying grassroots platforms preserves this copyright by design -- signed content cannot be unbundled from its signature, and the full provenance chain accumulates as content is forwarded -- so that ownership and possession coalesce in the person; and (\ic) copyright in digital speech acts is a prerequisite for digital sovereignty and democratic self-governance.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融科技】法律先例将计算机代码视为可受版权保护的表达形式。这些先例使得那些运行在企业服务器上的集中式数字平台（这些服务器存储着所有用户数据）能够通过版权、合同和技术架构的相互作用来构建私有的治理机制：几乎所有平台价值创造者都必须通过服务条款协议放弃对其内容的实际版权控制，作为参与平台的条件。相比之下，草根平台由使用加密技术进行身份验证的用户组成，他们独立于任何服务器或全球资源来操作自己的联网智能手机；每个人都在自己的设备上存储自己的数据，没有任何第三方拥有或中介这些数据。在这里，我们提出了“数字言语行为”（digital speech act）的概念——即个人使用私钥对自己的内容进行加密签名的一种自愿行为，这一行为发生在个人自己的设备上——通过这种行为，个人同时确立了所签名内容的归属权、责任归属以及作者身份。我们认为：（i）根据美国的现有法律先例，数字言语行为符合版权保护的条件：《Burrow-Giles》案将作者身份认定为基于自愿的创造性选择，而非机械或算法过程；《Feist》案为“最低限度的创造性”提供了标准；而设备上的持久数据存储满足了《版权法》对作品固定性的要求；（ii）草根平台所...。

papers.title: Analysis of the Impact of Profitability on Stock Returns for Banking Companies Listed on the Indonesia Stock Exchange, 2020–2024
papers.venue: Dinasti International Journal of Economics, Finance & Accounting
papers.abstract: This study aims to analyze the effect of profitability ratios on stock returns for banking companies listed on the Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX) during the 2020–2024 period. The independent variables used are Return on Assets (ROA), Return on Equity (ROE), Gross Profit Margin (GPM), Operating Profit Margin (OPM), and Net Profit Margin (NPM), while the dependent variable is stock returns. The research method used is a quantitative approach with multiple linear regression analysis. The results indicate that, collectively, all five profitability ratios significantly influence stock returns (R² = 0.710). Individually, ROE, GPM, and NPM have a significant positive effect, while ROA and OPM do not have a significant effect. NPM is the most dominant variable influencing stock returns. These findings indicate that profitability, particularly net profit and return on equity, is a key factor in attracting investor interest in the banking sector.
papers.summary_zh: 【资产定价】本研究旨在分析2020至2024年间，印尼证券交易所（IDX）上市的银行业公司的盈利能力比率对其股票回报的影响。所使用的自变量包括资产回报率（ROA）、股本回报率（ROE）、毛利率（GPM）、营业利润率（OPM）和净利润率（NPM），因变量为股票回报。研究方法采用定量分析，具体为多元线性回归分析。结果表明，这五个盈利能力比率共同对股票回报具有显著影响（R² = 0.710）。其中，股本回报率（ROE）、毛利率（GPM）和净利润率（NPM）对股票回报具有显著的正面影响，而资产回报率（ROA）和营业利润率（OPM）则没有显著影响。净利润率（NPM）是影响股票回报的最主要因素。这些发现表明，盈利能力，尤其是净利润率和股本回报率，是吸引投资者对银行业投资兴趣的关键因素。。研究方法：回归分析。

papers.title: A Study on Customer Perception Towards Gold Loan Service at Nagore
papers.venue: International Journal of Finance, Economics, and Management Studies
papers.abstract: This study examines customers’ perceptions of gold loan services offered by banks and non-banking financial institutions. Gold loans have become one of the most preferred financial services due to their quick processing, easy accessibility, minimal documentation, and immediate financial support. The main objective of this study is to analyse customer satisfaction and the factors influencing customers’ preferences for gold loan services. The study also focuses on important aspects such as interest rates, loan processing time, repayment facilities, safety of pledged gold, service quality, and trust towards financial institutions. The research is based on primary data collected through structured questionnaires from customers who use gold loan services, and secondary data from journals, websites, articles, and financial reports. Statistical tools such as percentage analysis, mean score analysis, chi-square analysis, correlation, and one-way ANOVA are used to analyse and interpret the collected data. The study is expected to reveal that factors such as quick loan approval, gold security, efficient customer service, and flexible repayment options significantly influence customers’ perceptions and satisfaction with gold loan services. The study concludes that maintaining transparency, reasonable interest rates, and quality service are essential for improving customer satisfaction and building long-term trust in gold loan services.
papers.summary_zh:
📌 研究问题：本研究旨在分析客户对黄金贷款服务的满意度及其偏好背后的影响因素。

🔬 研究方法：研究基于从黄金贷款客户处收集的一手问卷数据和二手文献资料，运用百分比分析、均值分析、卡方分析、相关性和单因素方差分析等统计工具进行数据处理。

📊 核心发现：研究发现，快速贷款审批、黄金安全性、高效客户服务和灵活的还款选项显著影响客户的感知与满意度。

💡 应用价值：研究结论指出，保持透明度、合理的利率以及高质量的服务对于提升客户满意度并建立对黄金贷款服务的长期

papers.title: Testing Centralized and Polycentric Computational Planning
papers.abstract: This paper presents a reproducible synthetic benchmark comparing a computational planner, an agent-based market, and a hybrid meta-market within a common simulated economy. The benchmark incorporates input-output production networks, heterogeneous firms, capacity constraints, endogenous prices, welfare metrics, structural shocks, adversarial stress testing, and information-reporting experiments. Across training, holdout, and adversarial scenarios, the planner consistently achieves lower welfare losses than the decentralized alternatives.   The main contribution is methodological rather than ideological. While the benchmark demonstrates a falsifiable framework for comparing economic coordination mechanisms, it does not establish the empirical superiority of planning. Several design choices mechanically favor the planner, including informational asymmetries, incomplete market representation, and simplified institutional assumptions. The results should therefore be interpreted as validation of a synthetic experimental architecture and as a prototype for future research. The paper concludes by outlining a validation agenda based on empirical calibration, structural holdouts, sensitivity analysis, uncertainty quantification, mechanism-design tests, and independent replication.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本文构建了一个可复现的合成基准测试框架，用于比较计算规划器、基于代理的市场模型以及混合式元市场在共同模拟经济环境中的表现。该基准测试涵盖了输入-输出生产网络、异质性企业、产能限制、内生价格机制、福利评估指标、结构性冲击、对抗性压力测试以及信息报告实验等内容。在训练数据、保留数据以及对抗性测试场景中，计算规划器始终能够实现比分散式替代方案更低的福利损失。本文的主要贡献在于方法论层面，而非意识形态层面。尽管该基准测试为比较经济协调机制提供了一个可验证的框架，但并未证明规划机制在实证上的优越性。某些设计选择（如信息不对称性、市场表示的不完整性以及简化的制度假设）在某种程度上对规划器有利。因此，研究结果应被视为对这种合成实验架构的有效验证，同时也为未来的研究提供了一个原型。文章最后提出了一个验证计划，包括基于实证校准的方法、结构性保留实验、敏感性分析、不确定性量化、机制设计测试以及独立重复实验等内容。。研究方法：实验方法。

papers.title: To Gamble, Perchance to Grow
papers.abstract: I study transformations of returns in the growth-optimal (Kelly) portfolio problem. In the one-safe-one-risky-asset problem, a return transform f universally produces a more conservative portfolio if and only if f is concave and strictly increasing and r/f is convex. As a corollary, I characterize comparative risk aversion for a rationally-inattentive agent: a more risk-averse agent is one who is sufficiently more risk averse in the Pratt (1964) sense.
papers.summary_zh:
📌 研究问题：本文研究增长最优投资组合问题中回报变换对投资组合选择的影响。

🔬 研究方法：通过分析一安全一风险资产问题，探讨了回报变换函数 $f$ 的性质及其对投资组合的影响。

📊 核心发现：在一安全一风险资产问题中，回报变换 $f$ 普遍产生更保守投资组合的充要条件是 $f$ 为凹且严格递增，且 $r/f$ 为凸。

💡 应用价值：该研究刻画了理性不关注代理人的相对风险厌恶，即更厌恶风险的代理人在普雷特（1964）意义上足够厌恶风险。

papers.title: Analysing drivers and interdependencies in European electricity markets using XAI
papers.abstract: Electricity markets are inherently complex systems characterised by strong nonlinearities, high-dimensional interactions, and increasing interdependence across regions. While deep neural networks (DNNs) have demonstrated strong predictive capabilities for electricity prices, their lack of interpretability limits their usefulness for understanding the underlying drivers of price formation. This paper addresses this gap by combining DNN models with explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) techniques to analyse the determinants of electricity prices across 39 European bidding zones. We employ SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations) to quantify feature contributions and apply and extend SSHAP, an aggregation framework to improve interpretability in high-dimensional settings. The analysis identifies that renewable energy sources, particularly solar, play a disproportionately important role in price formation despite their lower share in total power generation. Gas prices remain a dominant and consistent driver across electricity markets, while interconnections significantly shape price dynamics, highlighting the strong interdependence of European electricity systems. In addition, a synthetic EU-wide electricity market is constructed to explore the counterfactual scenario of a fully integrated market with a single price.
papers.summary_zh:
📌 研究问题：针对电力市场复杂系统中深度神经网络预测能力强但可解释性不足的问题，本文旨在分析欧洲电力市场的价格形成驱动因素及区域间的相互依赖性。

🔬 研究方法：本文采用深度神经网络结合可解释人工智能（XAI）技术，利用SHAP值量化特征贡献，并应用SSHAP框架来提升高维数据下的可解释性，对39个欧洲投标区域的电价进行分析。

📊 核心发现：研究发现可再生能源（特别是太阳能）在价格形成中起不成比例的重要作用，天然气价格是主导驱动因素，且区域互联显著影响价格动态；此外，构建的合成市场展示了单一价格完全整合的反事实情景。

💡 应用价值：该研究通过XAI技术揭示了欧洲电力系统的复杂驱动机制和相互依赖关系，为政策

papers.title: Wasserstein Policy Learning for Distributional Outcomes
papers.abstract: Offline policy learning has received growing attention in causal inference. The primary objective is to learn a policy (individualized treatment rule) as a mapping from covariates to treatment that maximizes the empirical welfare defined as the mean of scalar-valued potential outcomes. In this paper, we study offline policy learning with distribution-valued outcomes, where each potential outcome is a probability measure on $\mathbb{R}$ and the reward is defined through a utility functional applied to the Wasserstein barycenter of induced outcome distributions. We establish statistical guarantees for the policy learning framework based on both Inverse Probability Weighting (IPW) and Doubly Robust (DR) estimators. By handling the challenging uniform deviation over the product of the combinatorial policy class and the infinite-dimensional quantile domain, we prove that the finite-sample regret has leading dependence $\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{\mathrm{N\text{-}dim}(Π)/N})$. In the one-dimensional Wasserstein setting and under the stated regularity conditions, the leading regret rate is still governed by the policy-class complexity. Moreover, we provide a minimax lower bound establishing the sharpness of the leading dependence on $N$ and $\mathrm{N\text{-}dim}(Π)$.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】离线策略学习在因果推断领域受到了越来越多的关注。其主要目标是学习一种策略（即个性化的处理规则），该策略将协变量映射到处理方式上，从而最大化经验福利——这里的经验福利定义为标量值潜在结果的均值。在本文中，我们研究了具有分布值结果的离线策略学习问题，其中每个潜在结果都是定义在实数集$\mathbb{R}$上的概率测度，而奖励则是通过对诱导结果分布的Wasserstein重心应用效用函数来确定的。我们基于逆概率加权（IPW）和双重稳健（DR）估计量，为该策略学习框架建立了统计保证。通过处理组合策略类别与无限维分位数域之间的复杂偏差问题，我们证明了有限样本下的遗憾值具有主要依赖性，其表达式为$\widetilde{\mathcal{O}}(\sqrt{\mathrm{N\text{-}dim}(Π)/N})$。在一维Wasserstein框架下，并在满足特定规则性条件的情况下，主要的遗憾率仍然由策略类别的复杂性决定。此外，我们还提供了一个极小极大下界，进一步证明了这种主要依赖性对样本量$N$和$\mathrm{N\text{-}dim}(Π)$的敏感性。。研究方法：因果推断。

papers.title: An extendable, integrated, and dynamic approach to forecasting and stress-testing credit risk
papers.abstract: An integrated and extendable approach for stress-testing loan portfolios is presented, which includes both a loan production component and a credit risk component. In this approach, we simulate a completed portfolio using realistic loan parameters and distributional assumptions. Thereafter, we generate the uncertain cash flow history of these loans within a multistate probabilistic framework. We illustrate our approach using a simulation-based study, though the approach can be fit to real-world data. Such a simulation-based approach is ideal for stress-testing since it allows for evaluating a range of conditions. From these completed loans, we compute portfolio-level credit risk metrics, e.g., default and loss rates. Stress scenarios are introduced by varying the loan parameters accordingly within a broader Monte Carlo setup, thereby resulting in a range of portfolios. A classical approach to stress-testing does not typically integrate loan production or embed the correlation structure amongst risk metrics. In our approach, we integrate the forecasting of risk metrics with receipt-generation. Given data, the loan parameters within our extendable approach can be dynamically modelled as functions of input variables using any applicable technique. Overall, our approach can render predictions that are more dynamic and flexibly tuned, which can enhance stress-testing practices within any bank.
papers.summary_zh: 【银行与信贷】本文提出了一种集成且可扩展的贷款组合压力测试方法，该方法同时涵盖了贷款发放过程和信用风险分析两个方面。在该方法中，我们利用真实的贷款参数和分布假设来模拟已完成的贷款组合，并在多状态概率框架下生成这些贷款的不确定现金流历史数据。虽然该方法也可应用于实际数据，但我们通过基于仿真的研究来具体说明其应用过程。这种基于仿真的方法非常适合进行压力测试，因为它能够评估多种不同的情景。基于这些模拟结果，我们可以计算出组合层面的信用风险指标（如违约率和损失率）。通过调整贷款参数，在更广泛的蒙特卡洛模拟框架中引入压力测试场景，从而生成多种不同的贷款组合。传统的压力测试方法通常不结合贷款发放过程，也不考虑风险指标之间的相关性。而在我们的方法中，我们将风险指标的预测与现金流生成过程有机结合在一起。根据现有数据，可以使用任何适用的技术动态地建模可扩展方法中的贷款参数（这些参数作为输入变量的函数）。总体而言，我们的方法能够生成更具动态性和灵活性的预测结果，从而提升任何银行的压力测试实践效果。。研究方法：蒙特卡洛模拟、数值模拟。

papers.title: Implementation and Role of the Productive Waqf Incubation Program (IWP) of the Ministry of Religious Affairs of the Republic of Indonesia in the Development of Nazhir Entrepreneurship
papers.venue: Dinasti International Journal of Economics, Finance & Accounting
papers.abstract: This study examines the implementation and role of the Productive Waqf Incubation Program (IWP) of the Ministry of Religious Affairs of the Republic of Indonesia in developing nazhir entrepreneurship. The study is motivated by the large potential of waqf in Indonesia that has not yet been fully managed productively, since many waqf assets are still used for direct worship purposes and have not been directed toward sustainable socio-economic activities. This research aims to analyze the implementation of IWP, its role in strengthening the entrepreneurial capacity of nazhir, and its impact on local economic development and community welfare. This study uses a qualitative method with a descriptive approach. Data were obtained through observation of productive waqf practices, interviews with the Directorate of Zakat and Waqf Empowerment and nazhir who received the program, and documentation studies of regulations, reports, and related literature. The findings show that IWP is implemented through asset mapping, administrative and field verification, business feasibility assessment, nazhir training and certification, capital assistance distribution, mentoring, monitoring, evaluation, and business development. The program transforms nazhir from administrative managers into social entrepreneurship actors who are able to develop waqf assets productively, professionally, and accountably. This study concludes that IWP can serve as a sustainable productive waqf development model in Indonesia and can be replicated according to each region's local potential in a more adaptive, measurable, collaborative, inclusive, and public-benefit-oriented manner.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】本研究探讨了印度尼西亚宗教事务部推出的“生产性瓦克夫孵化计划”（Productive Waqf Incubation Program, IWP）在促进瓦克夫资产管理者（nazhir）创业能力发展方面的实施情况及其作用。该研究的出发点在于印度尼西亚瓦克夫资源的巨大潜力尚未得到充分开发——许多瓦克夫资产仍被用于宗教仪式活动，而非用于可持续的社会经济活动。本研究旨在分析IWP的具体实施机制、其在提升资产管理者创业能力方面的作用，以及其对当地经济发展和社区福祉的影响。研究采用定性研究方法，通过观察生产性瓦克夫管理实践、访谈扎卡特与瓦克夫管理部门及参与该计划的资产管理者，以及查阅相关法规、报告和文献来收集数据。

研究结果表明，IWP通过资产清查、行政与实地核查、商业可行性评估、资产管理者培训与认证、资金援助发放、指导服务、监督机制、评估体系以及业务发展支持等环节得以有效实施。该计划将资产管理者从单纯的行政管理者转变为能够高效、专业且负责任地运营瓦克夫资产的社会企业家。研究结论认为，IWP可作为印度尼西亚可持续的生产性瓦克夫发展模式，并可根据各地区实际情况进行适应性调整，以实现更具可衡量性...。

papers.title: A Study on Financial Management among Generation Z in Malang City
papers.venue: Dinasti International Journal of Economics, Finance & Accounting
papers.abstract: This research analyzes the effect of financial literacy, hedonic lifestyle, and fear of missing out (FOMO) on the financial management behavior of Generation Z in Malang City by involving locus of control as an intervening variable. The study applied a quantitative explanatory design using the Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM) technique with 385 respondents aged 18–27 years. The findings reveal that financial literacy does not significantly influence financial management behavior or locus of control. In contrast, hedonic lifestyle and FOMO demonstrate a significant relationship with locus of control, although FOMO does not directly affect financial management behavior. The results further indicate that locus of control positively contributes to financial management behavior and acts as a mediating variable in the relationship between hedonic lifestyle, FOMO, and financial management behavior. This study concludes that financial management behavior among Generation Z in the digital era is shaped not only by financial understanding, but also by psychological and social influences.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本研究分析了金融素养、享乐主义生活方式以及错失恐惧症（FOMO）对玛琅市Z世代财务管理行为的影响，并将控制点（locus of control）作为中介变量纳入考量。研究采用定量解释性设计，运用偏最小二乘结构方程模型（PLS-SEM）技术，对385名年龄在18至27岁之间的受访者进行了数据分析。研究结果表明，金融素养对财务管理行为或控制点并无显著影响；而享乐主义生活方式与控制点之间存在显著关联，尽管错失恐惧症本身并不直接影响财务管理行为。进一步分析发现，控制点对财务管理行为具有积极促进作用，并在享乐主义生活方式、错失恐惧症与财务管理行为之间的关系中起到中介作用。研究结论认为，在数字时代，Z世代的财务管理行为不仅受金融知识的影响，还受到心理和社会因素的制约。。
